declarations.description:
The written-out arpeggiated chord ("chord notated as consecutive pitches"):
a beamed run of `<music-note>`s followed by the target `<music-chord>` (or a
lone `<music-note>`). Each run note is tied to its matching-pitch chord tone;
the run does not consume beat duration.

This is the consecutive-pitch form. For the **wavy vertical line** use the
`arpeggio` attribute on `<music-note>` / `<music-chord>` instead.

The wrapper is layout-only (no shadow DOM); the staff reads the group and
draws the ties. Run notes with no `duration` are given `run-duration`.
declarations.name: ArpeggioElement

attributes.name: run-duration
attributes.description: Note value drawn for run notes that set no `duration` of their own. Defaults to `thirtysecond`.

attributes.name: unmatched
attributes.description: A run note whose pitch is not in the target chord becomes a laissez-vibrer tie (`lv`, default) or is dropped (`skip`).

attributes.name: lv-label
attributes.description: Draw an `l.v.` label on the laissez-vibrer ties this group produces.

declarations.description:
A chord: several noteheads sharing one stem. Supply the notes either as a
chord name via the `chord` attribute (e.g. `Cmaj7`) or as slotted
`<music-note>` children. Supports the same articulations, dynamics, hairpins,
ties/slurs and grace notes as `<music-note>`. Renders standalone or spaced
and beamed inside a `<music-staff>`.
declarations.name: ChordElement

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Note value for the chord. Defaults to `quarter`.

attributes.name: tie
attributes.description: Start or end of a tie, or `laissez-vibrer` (alias `lv`) for an open-ended "let ring" tie.

attributes.name: lv-label
attributes.description: Draw an `l.v.` label on a `tie="laissez-vibrer"` tie.

attributes.name: slur
attributes.description: Marks this chord as the start or end of a slur.

attributes.name: dynamic
attributes.description: Dynamic marking under the chord.

attributes.name: crescendo
attributes.description: Start or end of a crescendo hairpin.

attributes.name: decrescendo
attributes.description: Start or end of a decrescendo hairpin.

attributes.name: diminuendo
attributes.description: Alias of `decrescendo`.

attributes.name: articulation
attributes.description: Articulation/accent mark.

attributes.name: stress
attributes.description: Schoenberg stress mark.

attributes.name: arpeggio
attributes.description: Arpeggio sign left of the chord, spanning its notehead range: `up`, `up-arrow`, `down`, or `non-arpeggiate` (square bracket).

attributes.name: arpeggio-for
attributes.description: `id` of the upper-staff element this chord continues an unbroken cross-staff arpeggio from.

attributes.name: arpeggio-hairpin
attributes.description: A dynamic change during the roll: a vertical hairpin drawn left of the arpeggio sign. Honoured only with a rolled `arpeggio` (`up` / `up-arrow` / `down`).

attributes.name: arpeggio-hairpin-from
attributes.description: Dynamic letter at the start of the roll (bottom end for an upward roll), placed outside the staff.

attributes.name: arpeggio-hairpin-to
attributes.description: Dynamic letter at the end of the roll (top end for an upward roll), placed outside the staff.

attributes.name: arpeggiate
attributes.description: Marks the start or end of a `sempre arpeggiando` passage (every chord in it rolls unless it sets its own `arpeggio`).

attributes.name: grace
attributes.description: Comma-separated grace-note pitches preceding the chord, e.g. `"F#,G"`. The property also accepts a `Note[]`.

attributes.name: grace-octave
attributes.description: Comma-separated octaves aligned by index with `grace`. The property also accepts an `(Octave | null)[]`.

attributes.name: grace-articulation
attributes.description: Comma-separated per-grace articulation aligned by index with `grace`. The property also accepts an `(ArticulationType | null)[]`.

attributes.name: grace-type
attributes.description: Grace-note style. `trill` is a plain unslashed notehead (unlike `acciaccatura`'s crossed-through slash), for a leading grace note that introduces a trill. Defaults to `acciaccatura`.

attributes.name: grace-duration
attributes.description: Note value drawn for the grace notes.

attributes.name: grace-slur
attributes.description: Whether to draw the slur from the grace group to the chord. Defaults to `auto`.

attributes.name: grace-dynamic
attributes.description: A single dynamic for the whole grace group.

attributes.name: trill
attributes.description: Marks a trill start: draws the "tr" sign above the stave. Requires a staff (absent on a standalone chord). The wavy line spans forward through this chord's own `tie` chain — set `trill` once, not on every tied chord.

attributes.name: trill-line
attributes.description: `auto` (default) draws the wavy extension line, matching standard practice; `none` suppresses it (e.g. bare sign only on an isolated, untied note-value).

attributes.name: trill-stop
attributes.description: Draws a vertical end-notch here instead of letting the line run to the next notehead.

attributes.name: trill-accidental
attributes.description: Overrides only the accidental of the trilling (auxiliary) pitch — normally the diatonic upper neighbor as modified by the key signature (the chord's topmost note). Never changes the letter itself. Ignored (with a warning) when `trill-note` is also set.

attributes.name: trill-note
attributes.description: Full override of the trilling pitch (letter + accidental), rendered as a small written notehead in parentheses after the chord's own notehead column — required when the trilling pitch shares the reference note's own letter (a chromatic/semitone trill) or otherwise isn't the plain diatonic neighbor. Wins over `trill-accidental` when both are set.

attributes.name: trill-continuation
attributes.description: Controls a trill's line restatement after a system break, once its tie chain has carried it there. `bracketed` (default) redraws the sign in parentheses; `line-only` resumes with no restated sign. Ignored at an ordinary same-row barline (always resumes silently there). Meaningful only on the chord that started the trill.

attributes.name: trill-finish
attributes.description: Comma-separated grace-note pitch(es) placed *after* this chord (a trill's finishing/closing figure), e.g. `"F#,G"`. The property also accepts a `Note[]`. Always a plain unslashed notehead (no `grace-type` equivalent).

attributes.name: trill-finish-octave
attributes.description: Comma-separated octaves aligned by index with `trill-finish`; empty slots use this chord's reference octave. The property also accepts an `(Octave | null)[]`.

attributes.name: trill-finish-slur
attributes.description: Which slur(s) the finishing grace note(s) draw: back to this chord (`to-main`, default), forward to the next note/chord (`to-next`), `both`, or `none`.
Chord name resolved into constituent pitches, e.g. `C`, `Am`, `Cmaj7`, `G/B`.

declarations.description:
One bar of music. Groups one or more staves (a single staff, or a grand
staff / choir when it holds several), draws the vertical bar-line connector
through them, and sizes itself to the widest staff's minimum width. Key
signature, mode and time inherited from a parent `<music-composition>` can be

members.name: staffResizeObserver
members.default: new ResizeObserver((entries) => { const newWidth = entries[0].contentRect.width; if (newWidth !== this.#lastStaffWidth) { this.#lastStaffWidth = newWidth; this.onStaffResize(); } })

members.name: upgradeAssignedElements
members.description:
Force-upgrade slotted `<music-*>` children (and any nested inside a
`<music-tuplet>`) before the staff reads their getters. When a staff is
built from parsed HTML markup its `connectedCallback` runs — and dispatches
the first `slotchange` — before its already-present children upgrade, so
without this their getters (`grace`, `note`, `duration`, …) are `undefined`.
`customElements.upgrade()` is synchronous and a no-op on an already-upgraded
or unregistered element.
